text: Plan reconciliation section caught 7 assumption mismatches (types, endpoints, UI fields) with file:line references. Prevented writing code against wrong state. Zero rework due to plan accuracy.

Architecture-critique flagged 2 CRITICAL findings (roster expectations, missing userId) before code was written. Builder corrected test assertions before implementation. Critique feedback was immediately actionable.

TDD red phase: 34 tests written (20 integration + 10 component + 4 auto-open). All passed on first green-phase run. Protected tests (14 existing SetupFlow tests) passed without modification despite large API changes.
All 5 ACs delivered in single implementation attempt. Zero rework commits. Backward-compatible defaults (functions array) preserved existing contract. No environment issues or test flakiness.

Design-to-code label drift: 'Marketing' preset designed as [marketing,product] (4 agents) but implemented as [marketing] only (3 agents). 'Software+Design' designed with that label but implemented as 'Eng+UX'. Deviations from approved design not captured as lore.

Architecture plan test assertions were factually wrong for 3 of 4 test cases (roster expectations). Architect trusted design table instead of deriving from defaultRoster() directly. Builder corrected during implementation but added debugging step.

Dead code: buildingContext field added to CreateTeamRequest type but never used end-to-end. SetupFlow doesn't capture it, server doesn't read it, welcome message doesn't include it. Represents incomplete scope execution.
Hardcoded RGBA in selected pill background (rgba(22,118,79,0.06)) breaks theme portability. Design specified it; builder faithfully implemented. Future concern if dark mode support is added.

Recurring: Architecture test assertions written against design tables instead of actual function behavior. Similar issue in previous workpackages. Recommendation: /architecture skill must specify assertions call the actual function.

Recurring: Design-to-code label/naming drift without lore documentation. Builder made pragmatic choices (match actual defaultRoster output instead of design table) but didn't record reasoning. Recommendation: /write-code rule for lore at deviation points.
